notes: The official start command installs the schema once (--install --idempotent), applies migrations (--upgrade) and starts listmonk, all configured from LISTMONK_* variables (--config ''). On the first install it creates the Super Admin admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD; later starts keep the existing users.

Set the Root URL to https://<your domain> under Settings → General after the first login. Listmonk keeps it in the database (default http://localhost:9000) and environment variables cannot override it; links in emails and public pages use it.
Sending campaigns needs an SMTP provider, configured under Settings → SMTP.
Uploads go to /listmonk/uploads, the default media path, in its own named volume. PostgreSQL 17.11 (the official compose's major version, pinned) has its own volume and no published port.
Listmonk is a single Go binary; the 256m floor leaves ample headroom. The database uses the panel database-memory default.
